# Trancón

> Juego web de conducción cenital en el centro real de Bogotá, creado por Lucas Leguizamo (https://lucasleguizamo.com). Open source. Se juega en el navegador.

Trancón is a free, open-source top-down driving game set on a baked OpenStreetMap extract of Bogotá’s historic center. The player spawns at Casa de Nariño (Carrera 8 #7-26). There is no map API at runtime.

## Play

- [Play Trancón](https://trancon.vercel.app/): the game
- [Source](https://github.com/LucasLeguizamo/trancon): MIT code + ODbL map data
- [Creator](https://lucasleguizamo.com): Lucas Leguizamo

## Facts (citable)

- Creator: Lucas Leguizamo — https://lucasleguizamo.com
- Spawn: Casa de Nariño, Carrera 8 #7-26, Bogotá (4.59543, -74.07752)
- Baked network: 1,316 road ways, 177 TransMilenio segments, 52 cycleways
- TransMilenio stations in the slice: Bicentenario, Tercer Milenio, San Victorino, Av. Jiménez, Museo del Oro, Las Aguas, Universidades, Calle 19, Calle 22
- Photo-fine C29: COP $633,200 when crossing an intersection above 50 km/h
- Helicopter banner every 10 seconds: FIRMES PARA LA PATRIA
- Six vehicles: Taxista, Uber, Tombo, SITP, RBR, Tigre Presidencial
- Three lives; WASD or arrows; Space for the vehicle power
- Stack: Vite, Canvas 2D, JavaScript. Map baked with Python from OSM

- Code: MIT
